summary: The section-cite reader requires the parenthetical, so the 354 comment cites in the ratified comma-less spelling are unjudged — and 50 of them name a heading their page does not hold

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: a section cite resolves whenever its emphasized or quoted half sits adjacent to the page name, comma and parenthetical optional, and every span the widened arm reads names a heading its page holds
tests: the citation scan reads a section cite spelled without its parenthetical
pins: an emphasized aside that does not sit adjacent to a page name draws no section cite
notes: Ruled off the cite-grammar record, fork (a). Re-measured this drain over `src/`, `harness/`, `tests/`: 354 spans in the widened spelling, 304 resolving, 50 stale across the 21 files named here — near-uniformly abbreviations the page already rules a rewrite. Today's narrowness is spelled in `SECTION_CITE`'s own doc, which the widening rewrites. The rendered-surface and page-arm readers add nothing: measured red-free. Seams the same reader with THE-INTERFACE-PAGES-SECTION-CITES-RESOLVE.
